description: React component implementing a calculator interface with state management, input handling, and keyboard support.

methods.name: isDigitKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key is a numeric digit (0-9).

methods.name: formatNumberForDisplay
methods.description: Formats a number for display, avoiding scientific notation and normalizing -0 to 0.

methods.name: applyOperator
methods.description: Performs arithmetic operation based on the operator provided; handles division by zero.

methods.name: resetAll
methods.description: Resets calculator state to initial values.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the calculator display to an error state.

methods.name: currentDisplayNumber
methods.description: Converts the display string into a number, handling NaN cases.

methods.name: inputDigit
methods.description: Handles digit input, updating display accordingly.

methods.name: inputDecimal
methods.description: Handles decimal point input, ensuring only one decimal per number.

methods.name: deleteOne
methods.description: Deletes the last character from the display, resetting to '0' when empty.

methods.name: toggleSign
methods.description: Toggles the sign of the current display number.

methods.name: chooseOperator
methods.description: Handles operator selection, performing sequential calculations.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Executes the current pending operation or repeats the last operation.

methods.name: toneClasses
methods.description: Returns CSS class names based on button tone (primary, accent, danger).
